name: Joab
summary: A son of Zeruiah and the captain of David's army, who led many of David's battles. He killed Abner, Absalom and Amasa with his own hand, and in Solomon's day he was put to death at the altar.

key_moments.title: The Pool of Gibeon
key_moments.description: Joab's men and Abner's men met at the pool of Gibeon, and a fierce battle followed. Abner's men lost, and Joab's brother Asahel was killed chasing Abner.

key_moments.title: Killing Abner
key_moments.description: When Joab heard David had sent Abner away in peace, he called Abner back to Hebron. He took him aside in the gate and killed him for the blood of his brother Asahel.

key_moments.title: David's Letter About Uriah
key_moments.description: David wrote to Joab to put Uriah in the front of the fiercest fighting. Joab set Uriah where the strongest enemy men were, and Uriah was killed.

key_moments.title: The Death of Absalom
key_moments.description: The king told his captains to deal gently with Absalom. But when Absalom hung caught in an oak, Joab thrust three darts into his heart.

key_moments.title: Holding the Altar
key_moments.description: Joab had followed Adonijah, and when he heard the news he fled and caught hold of the altar. Solomon sent Benaiah, who killed him there for the innocent blood he had shed.
